## What's free

Free managed DNS: unlimited zones and queries, anycast across 210+ PoPs, 1 dynamic (GeoDNS/failover) record set per zone; CDN and edge cloud are pay-as-you-go

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://gcore.com/pricing/edge-network> before relying on this.

## Notes

Health checks on the free DNS plan run every 120 s. The same provider manages Gcore CDN and edge VMs, which are billed.

## Plan

- `stack/`: a root module that reads the hybrid inventory (`hybrid/` state) and wires every host (DNS records, mesh ACLs, tunnels)
